rows.grounds: sequential particle introducing the next ritual rule
genitive of kārttika-māsa, the month of Kārttika
locative of śukla-pratipad, first day of the bright fortnight

items.question: Is the Kaula observance to be performed certainly on the first day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika?
premises: The rule names Kārttika month as its temporal frame.
The bright fortnight first day is specified as the occasion.
items.inference: The verse fixes the rite to the first bright day of Kārttika with unqualified certainty.
uncertainties: The sentence is fragmentary and the main action is not stated in these four tokens.
items.plain_english: Then, in the month of Kārttika, on the first day of the bright fortnight, certainly.
